description.zh:
告警ID。

获取告警ID，请参见[ListAlertEvents - 查询告警事件历史](~~2612346~~)。
description.en:
The ID of the alert.

For more information about how to obtain the ID of an alert, see [ListAlertEvents](~~2612346~~).

description.zh: 告警等级。告警严重程度从P4、P3、P2、P1逐级上升。
description.en: The severity level of the alert. Valid values: P1, P2, P3, and P4. P4 indicates the lowest severity, whereas P1 indicates the highest severity.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms change-alarm-severity --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --alarm-id 184723093 --severity P1 --handler-id 2046076 --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
